events.title: Second nationwide day of Yellow Vest (Act II) protests in France, about 410,000 marchers and over 1,000 arrests
Chamber sends the bill abolishing ČT and ČRo licence fees to second reading after an overnight sitting; President Pavel criticises the procedure, protests in Prague and Brno
events.note: Not announced in advance of the freeze: the coalition added the bill to the Chamber agenda unexpectedly on Friday 23 Oct, after the edition froze at 04:48 that day; the decision to sit on Friday and Saturday was taken on Thursday evening and not published.

events.title: Typhoon Champi makes landfall in Taiwan, one dead and more than 500 injured
events.note: Not a scheduled event; the storm track was forecast days ahead by the Central Weather Administration, but the paper does not plan weather events abroad.
